storyCards.fact:
M.c. Hammer's "Pray" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Pray" is a song from American rapper and dancer MC Hammer's third album, Please Hammer Don't Hurt 'Em (1990).

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Pray was released in 1990.
